en.headline: Woman robbed of HK$11,000 cash in Amoy Plaza stairwell in Ngau Tau Kok
en.dek: A 22-year-old woman was pushed from behind and had cash snatched late on Friday night while heading to an ATM; police are seeking a man in a grey sweatshirt.
body: Police are investigating a robbery that took place at about 11pm on Friday at Amoy Plaza Phase 2 in Ngau Tau Kok.

A 22-year-old woman surnamed Wong told officers that while she was walking through the stairwell at 77 Ngau Tau Kok Road, a man pushed her from behind and snatched approximately HK$11,000 in cash before fleeing towards Ngau Tau Kok Road. She had been on her way to deposit the money at an automated teller machine. No injuries were reported.

Officers arrived promptly and classified the case as robbery. It has been handed to the Sau Mau Ping District Crime Investigation Unit. The suspect is described as a man aged between 20 and 30, about 1.7 metres tall, wearing a grey long-sleeved sweatshirt, dark trousers and a face mask at the time.
Police are reviewing footage and appealing for information.

zh.headline: 牛頭角淘大商場梯間女子被搶走約一萬一千元現金
zh.dek: 二十二歲女子周五晚約十一時在商場梯間被男從後推撞並搶走現金，警方正追緝穿灰色長袖衛衣男子。
body: 警方正調查周五晚約十一時在牛頭角淘大商場二期發生的搶劫案。
二十二歲黃姓女子向警方表示，當時正步行經過牛頭角道77號商場梯間，一名男子突然從後推撞她，並搶走約一萬一千元現金後逃向牛頭角道。事主當時正前往自動櫃員機存款。事件中無人受傷。
警員迅速到場，將案件列作搶劫處理，並交由秀茂坪區重案組跟進。疑犯為二十至三十歲男子，身高約一點七米，發案時穿灰色長袖衛衣、深色長褪及戴口罩。
警方正翻查閉路電視及呼籲市民提供資料。
